column1: # Benchling: cDNA005_serum/plasma enrichment pilot (EXP26000992) / BFX request EXP26000993
# TwistPool0184; 375 ng of each library into hybridisation capture (equal mass)
# NOT an input titration - all four libraries are 1 ng. Sample-type comparison:
#   human plasma vs chimeric-mouse serum vs PHH, at fixed input.
# polya: artificial = enzymatic PAP tailing on serum/plasma RNA (fragmented, lacks tails)
#        selected   = oligo-dT selection on intact cellular RNA (the cDNA003 route)
#        These are NOT comparable to each other.
# custom_bc03 = SeqLib5552, carried over from EXP26000892 (cDNA003). Same physical
#        library, re-pooled and re-captured. Cross-run technical replicate.
#        In EXP26000892 it gave 3,800 UMI molecules / 1,090 distinct coordinates
#        at 21.2M reads; here it received only 6.9M, so depth differs ~3x.
# pcr = second-anneal cycle count (a fixed 5-cycle block precedes it).
